_doc: PLAN.md 4.4, Phase 4.3. Guns and the mounts they sit on. Distances in U, angles in degrees, time in seconds. An edge gun covers edge_u of a hardpoint edge (edge_u / port_pitch ports) and its barrel sticks out length_u, which is also the space it blocks. A turret sits on a hardpoint's face, which must hold a circle of turret_radius_u. over_hull: the gun sits on top of the ship and fires over its own tiles (owner, 2026-10-26: top-mounted guns can, side-mounted can't). rate is shots per second; a shot flies at speed_u U/s on top of the ship's own velocity and goes range_u. spread_deg is [at L1, at the top level]: the random scatter either side of the aim, which narrows as the gun levels up, on a log curve (owner, 2026-10-26: accuracy comes with level). A gun with spin_up_s (the multi gatling) starts at rate_start and reaches rate after firing that long; it winds down over spin_down_s when it stops. pierce is the share of armor a shot ignores (PLAN.md 4.5). Phase 4.6a: a shot with splash_u explodes where it hits, dealing splash_damage of splash_type to every tile in reach (and destroying enemy rockets there); with airburst it also explodes when its fuse runs out, timed to reach its target. pellets fires that many shots per trigger (flak). homing_deg_s steers a shot toward the target it was fired at. A rocket can be shot down by an explosion; an anti_missile gun also targets enemy rockets. Rockets come in four (owner, 2026-10-26): homing (Seeker) or fire-and-forget, each with an HE warhead (big splash) or AP (concentrated damage, small splash). Phase 4.6b: a beam (laser) hits instantly along its barrel up to range_u, in pulses of `damage` at `rate` a second; it heats up over heat_s of firing, then overheats and stops until it has cooled (over cool_s from full) to heat_resume. A gun with rear_only goes only on an edge facing the back. A mine (proximity_u) is dropped behind at speed_u, slowed by drag, lives life_s, and explodes when an enemy comes within proximity_u; on auto it's dropped while an enemy is within range_u. family groups the guns in the hangar palette. The numbers are L1; weapon_xp.json says what levels do (4.8b).

aim._doc: A gun fires once its barrel is within fire_within_deg of its aim. A fixed gun on auto fires when a target's lead point is that close to straight ahead.
